answer: One identity, one registered lighthouse-keeper posting: a lighthouse on a named rock, one keeper for 90 days. The keeper logs the lamp through its nadir hour; the relief crew countersigns when the supply boat rides the tide in, and the authority checks it against the light list: one lighthouse, one identity. Each fake costs one real person, 90 days on the rock, 1,200 units; 100 fakes cost 120,000 units and 9,000 keeper-days. Cheapest cheat: hire a stand-in, but the stand-in burns their own one posting, and a forged log fails the light-list check while the relief voyage exposes it.
